title: Pricing Memorandum — A Give-Back Made to Put Right the Chain's Own Handling, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Pricing Memorandum — A Give-Back Made to Put Right the Chain's Own Handling, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

A give-back on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan made to put right a failure of the chain's own handling is recorded under the service-recovery ground, does not consume the courtesy allowance the term sets, and is worked out as the charges it answers together with the additions the desk makes for the failure.

**The charges the give-back answers** are the lateness charges booked to the plan inside the stretch of whole calendar months the charge reading runs over. The stretch the charge reading runs over is the term's repeat window of whole calendar months ending on the handling date, as the fee schedule states that window for the plan's promotional term.

**The addition for repeated failure.** No addition is made for repeated failure.

**The addition for the workshop.** No addition is made for the workshop.

**The give-back.** The charges the give-back answers, the addition for repeated failure and the addition for the workshop are added, that sum is rounded to the cent, and where the rounded figure falls below nothing the give-back stands at nothing; the give-back is booked against the most recently booked lateness charge on the plan and carries the whole of that sum.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

A plan written on a promotional term whose repeat window is 6 whole calendar months carries, inside the 6 whole months ending on the handling date, two lateness charges: one of 29.00 USD booked four months ago and one of 39.00 USD booked last month.

- *The charges the give-back answers*: 29.00 USD together with 39.00 USD, that is 68.00 USD.
- *The addition for repeated failure*: nothing.
- *The addition for the workshop*: nothing.
- *The give-back*: 68.00 USD together with nothing and nothing is 68.00 USD; rounded to the cent the give-back is **68.00 USD**, booked against the 39.00 USD charge as the most recently booked lateness charge on the plan and carrying the whole of the 68.00 USD.
